Bug_Title: SA: Self assignment of local rather than assignment to field (SA_LOCAL_SELF_ASSIGNMENT_INSTEAD_OF_FIELD)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the setFoo method where the local parameter 'foo' is assigned to itself instead of assigning it to the instance field 'foo'. This results in the field 'foo' never being updated.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method which internally calls the setFoo method. The setFoo method contains a self-assignment bug where the local variable 'foo' is assigned to itself instead of the instance field 'foo'. As a result, the value of the field 'foo' remains unchanged, causing the assertion to fail.
